title: At the gift shop
instructions: Bir turist hediyelik eşya dükkânında alışveriş yapıyor. Ne aldığına ve fiyata dikkat et.

script.speaker: tourist
script.text: Excuse me. How much are these postcards?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: They're fifty pence each, or five for two pounds.

script.speaker: tourist
script.text: Five, please. And I'd like a T-shirt for my son.

script.speaker: tourist
script.text: He's ten years old. Small, I think.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Here you are. This blue one is very popular.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Twelve pounds. So that's fourteen pounds altogether.

questions.prompt: How many postcards does she buy?

questions.evidence: I'd like a T-shirt for my son.

questions.prompt: How much does she pay altogether?
questions.feedback: Tişört on iki, kartpostallar iki pound: toplam on dört.
